tool_args.title: Biography of Narendra Modi
tool_args.content: Narendra Damodardas Modi (born 17 September 1950) is an Indian politician serving as the 14th Prime Minister of India since 2014. He was the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014. Key milestones include his tenure in Gujarat, the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the Digital India initiative, and the Swachh Bharat Mission. He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
